messages:
ashley: P1 from acme-ops. Sudden error storm: auth 403s and elevated p50 -> p95 latencies. They say traffic routed to eu-west when it should be hitting us-west. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4532 opened 2024-11-21T08:12Z
mike: when did it start and any trace ids?
ashley: customer timeline shows spike around 2024-11-21T08:10Z-08:12Z, provided sample x-request-id r-0c9f2 for a failed request after routing changed
infra-bot: heartbeat-monitor at 2024-11-21T08:10:58Z reported edge probe timeouts for us-west (2/3 failed), region transitioned to DEGRADED then UNHEALTHY
raman: pulled logs for r-0c9f2 -> auth-validate failed: token_aud mismatch (expected=redwood-us-west got=redwood-eu-west). KMS: decrypt error key_missing for tenant t-acme
lina: sounds like a keys/issuer mismatch in eu-west. Why did probes time out though? internal node metrics looked fine for serving
ops-bot: edge-probe logs: multiple probes from us-west returned 504 between 08:09:40Z-08:11:10Z. NAT gateway egress queue depth spiked, some probe retries saw upstream backpressure
mike: so transient NAT egress saturation caused probe timeouts -> region health tripped -> routing policy sent traffic to eu-west -> serving there lacks tenant keys so auths 403. Also cross-region routing adds latency
ashley: support repro steps they sent:
```
# from us-west dev box
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.us-west.example/v1/complete  # 200
# after automatic failover
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <same token>" https://api.redwood.eu-west.example/v1/complete  # 403, x-request-id: r-0c9f2
```
raman: mitigations proposed: 1) manual routing pin for acme to us-west 2) kick off KMS mirror for tenant t-acme to eu-west as fallback 3) add a failover-safety check for tenants with non-replicated secrets
lina: short-term guard: make failover require synthetic auth probe success for a tenant-scoped canary before marking region UNHEALTHY for that tenant
mike: applied manual override at 2024-11-21T08:24:00Z to keep acme on us-west, confirming traffic normalizing
ashley: customer reports latency back to normal after override, but some requests that hit eu-west during the window still returned 403s (they captured ~30 ids)
raman: started KMS mirror job for t-acme at 2024-11-21T08:28:00Z, initial sync ETA ~10-15m
ops-bot: created a short-lived mitigation: add tenant t-acme to routing-exclusion list for automatic failover until keys replicated
mike: I'll open RFC to update the default routing policy: add per-tenant replication-aware failover and an "auth-sensitive" mode for enterprise routes
lina: infra action: reduce single-egress NAT dependency for edge probes, add randomized probe egress selection to avoid correlated failures
ashley: postmortem plan: timeline, NAT gateway metrics, probe traces, KMS replication gap, and recommended product change (auth-safe failover). I'll draft and include customer timeline
support-bot: ticket#4532 updated: manual override applied, KMS mirror in progress, customer notified with interim workaround
raman: monitoring: watch for remaining 403s after KMS mirror completes, verify no new region flips for acme tenants
ashley: will follow up once mirror finishes and we'll close P1 after 24h of stable behavior. Thanks team :thankyou:
